purpose: Soak burn-in: 4 consecutive production-chain fires via the OS task scheduler (schtasks //Run nlh-daily-rotate), plus a runner-outage recovery demo mid-soak. No secrets; run IDs and timestamps only.
method: Each fire: schtasks //Run -> scheduled task executes scripts/nlh.py rotate (seal -> dispatch -> self-hosted runner consumes -> sha round-trip -> OANDA drift check -> state write). Post-fire checks from cloud API + last_rotate.json. Verification code never dispatched runs outside the chain.

fires.recovery: queued job survived runner outage and completed on runner restart; chain failure was state-recorded per drift contract

summary.scheduler_attributed: every run created only by the scheduled task's own dispatch; no manual/agent dispatch outside the chain
summary.observed_reliability: 4/4 chain successes across ~27 minutes; 1/1 queued-job recovery after forced runner outage
